title: Quarterly Security Audit
description: Recurring security review for managed client sites — run after major updates or quarterly.

steps.title: Review Administrator Users
steps.instructions: List all users with administrator or super-admin roles. Remove contractors, former staff, and unused service accounts.

steps.title: Audit Application Passwords
steps.instructions: Revoke unused Application Passwords on each admin account. Document which integrations still require active credentials.

steps.title: Check Plugin & Theme Updates
steps.instructions: Review available updates and changelogs. Prioritize security patches for plugins handling forms, login, or e-commerce.

steps.title: Scan for Unexpected Files
steps.instructions: Check uploads/, wp-content/, and web root for suspicious PHP files, .htaccess changes, or unknown admin users.

steps.title: Verify SSL Certificate
steps.instructions: Confirm the certificate is valid, auto-renewing, and serves the full chain without mixed-content warnings on key pages.

steps.title: Test Backup Restore
steps.instructions: Restore the latest backup to staging and confirm the site boots, logins work, and media loads correctly.

steps.title: Review Security Headers
steps.instructions: Verify HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy headers on production responses.
